notablePrerequisites: The opponent after you in turn order has a life total that is divisible by 5.
description:
Cast Volrath's Dungeon for {2}{B}{B}.
Target the opponent who's turn is after yours with Mindslaver.
On their turn, force them to pay 5 life to destroy Volrath's Dungeon while holding priority.
With the destroy trigger on the stack, repeat this process until they have 0 life.
